verses.1: A psalm for giving thanks. Shout to the LORD, all the earth.
verses.2: Serve the LORD with joy. Come before his presence with singing.
verses.3: Know this: the LORD is the God who made us, and we are his people, the flock of his pasture.
verses.4: Enter his gates with thanks, his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, bless his name.
verses.5: For the LORD is good forever. His steadfast love endures from generation to generation.

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: "A psalm for giving thanks" reflects the technical meaning of "mizmor letodah."
- v. 5: "His steadfast love" and "his faithfulness" are standard renderings of chesed and emunah in poetic context.
raw:
[1] A psalm for giving thanks. Shout to the LORD, all the earth.

[2] Serve the LORD with joy. Come before his presence with singing.

[3] Know this: the LORD is the God who made us, and we are his people, the flock of his pasture.

[4] Enter his gates with thanks, his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, bless his name.

[5] For the LORD is good forever. His steadfast love endures from generation to generation.

---
Notes
- v. 1: "A psalm for giving thanks" reflects the technical meaning of "mizmor letodah."
- v. 5: "His steadfast love" and "his faithfulness" are standard renderings of chesed and emunah in poetic context.
